item.title: ACCA Endorses Employer-Directed Skills Act to Strengthen HVACR Workforce
item.description: The bill directly supports ACCA’s 2025-26 policy priority to strengthen the HVACR workforce by making federal workforce development funds more accessible to contractors’ in-house training programs.

item.title: Protecting Inverter-Driven HVAC Systems: The Critical Role of Power Quality Monitoring and Management
item.description: Inverter-driven HVAC systems deliver 30–50% energy savings — but their sensitive electronics are highly vulnerable to voltage instability.

item.title: Winsupply Family of Companies Donates $250,000 in PPE to Area Agencies
item.description: Throughout the year, Winsupply Sourcing Services also supports charities such as Habitat for Humanity with construction building materials, said Robert Kellar, senior director, operations, Winsupply Sourcing LLC.

item.title: Groups Join Forces to Promote Product Certification
item.description: The partnership is designed to help HARDI LATAM members better understand and communicate the competitive advantage of AHRI certification in Latin American markets, where product differentiation is critical in highly price-competitive environments.

item.title: HARDI Distributors Report 2.8% Sales Growth for 2025
item.description: Sales increased by 2.4% in December, and overall growth for 2025 came in at 2.8%.

item.title: How OTA Updates Can Make HVAC Smarter, After Installation
item.description: In the HVACR industry, the potential for equipment to become smarter after its installation is still relatively new. But as manufacturers explore how connectivity and software can improve performance, reliability, and customer service, OTA updates are emerging as promising possibilities.

item.title: Electrification Laws Gain Momentum, Forcing HVAC Contractors to Adapt
item.description: From equipment restrictions to incentive-driven transitions, state electrification efforts are influencing how contractors sell, install, and plan for the future.

item.title: Airborne Act Reintroduced
item.description: Two House members, a Democrat and a Republican, revived a bill that was also considered in previous sessions.

item.title: Know a Champion of Distribution? Tell us!
item.description: A new awards program, Champions of Distribution, highlights the people and companies making a difference in distribution.

item.title: HVAC Trends: Artificial Intelligence and HVACR
item.description: immy Thompson, senior sales manager, HVAC, at Podium, talked with us about how AI helps contractors communicate with homeowners, how contractors can take the first step toward implementing AI, how AI can help build authentic connections, and the biggest AI barrier’s he’s seeing from techs in the field.
